question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A remedy to counteract the effects of poison.
solution:
The correct answer is **Antidote.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antidote** means a medical substance that is used to prevent a poison or a disease from having an effect.

 ** •* Example*- ***Regular exercise is the best **antidote** to tiredness and depression.*

 
• So, it is clear that the** 'Antidote'** can be used as a one-word substitute for** 'A remedy to counteract the effects of poison.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Antibody** means a substance that the body produces in the blood to fight disease.
 
• **Antiseptic **means a liquid or cream that prevents a cut, etc. from becoming infected.
 
• **Antibiotic** means a medicine which is used for destroying bacteria and curing infections.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**
